findings.evidence: `roadmap/.../Suggested.lean:61` declares `exists_mem_support_height_reflectionPerm_lt ... (hj) (hj' : j ∉ b.support)`, while lines 82–87 expose that name without `hj'`; lines 91–99 contain the intended positive nonsimple result under another name.
findings.fix: Give the nonsimple lowering theorem the roadmap name (including `hj'`, and preferably the `IsPos` conclusion needed by induction), and rename or privatize the weaker height-only helper.
findings.issue: `exists_mem_support_height_reflectionPerm_lt` omits the roadmap target’s `j ∉ b.support` argument and does not guarantee the reflected root remains positive; the stronger result is instead exposed as `exists_mem_support_isPos_reflectionPerm_height_lt`, so downstream code using the advertised named target cannot obtain the intended lowering step under that name.

findings.evidence: Lines 59–63 give a one-way normal-form equation from `b.height (P.reflectionPerm i j)` to arithmetic data, with no competing reverse rewrite.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `height_reflectionPerm_of_mem_support` (and verify it simplifies the left-hand reflected-height expression to the stated subtraction).
findings.issue: The characteristic simple-root computation `height_reflectionPerm_of_mem_support` is not marked `@[simp]`, so simplification cannot normalize reflected height even when support membership is available.

summary: The roadmap’s named lowering API is occupied by a theorem with a different interface, while the actual nonsimple positive-root lowering result has an unexpected longer name.
